leave_absence_reporting_013.evidence: Any employee who finds it necessary to be absent from his/her position because of illness shall notify his/her immediate supervisor before the work day begins if possible. If not possible, notification should be made as soon thereafter as possible.
leave_absence_reporting_013.coder_notes: Revised from 'not_discussed' to 'yes'. The document explicitly specifies absence reporting procedures in Article 8, Section A.1.b, requiring teachers to notify their immediate supervisor before the work day begins.
